purpose: The runtime and tool versions Haskell and Nix/NixOS support is built, tested and supported against. Checked by scanner/test/language/language-package-ci.test.js against package.json, the CI workflow and the code that probes each tool. A version here is a statement of what was exercised, not a promise about untested versions.

haskell.kind: in-process lexer, layout resolver and extractor over SHA-256-pinned grammar tables

nix.kind: in-process lexer and parser over SHA-256-pinned grammar tables

web-tree-sitter.reason: held with tree-sitter-wasms 0.1.13 as an ABI pair; see .dependency-holds.json

existing.python-ast: optional python3 subprocess, regex fallback when absent

ghc.used by: compile verification of a fix (opt-in) and the HS-006 route-fixture compile criterion
ghc.when absent: the compile gate reports not-run, and a criterion that needs the compiler FAILS (never skips)

nix.used by: opt-in isolated evaluation (AGENTIC_SECURITY_NIX_EVAL=1) and the NixOS runtime checks
nix.when absent: evaluation is reported as unsupported with the reason; static results are retained

sandbox.used by: isolation of the evaluator (macOS sandbox-exec, Linux namespaces)

hostsExercised.ghc: 9.4.8 (Homebrew ghc@9.4, with libpq; the route-fixture packages installed with cabal 3.x, scotty pinned at 0.20.1)
hostsExercised.note: development host of the loop run. GHC was installed late, so the compile criteria (HS-006.AC01) ran here; nix and NixOS were never available, so NIX-011 and NIX-012 could not be executed here
hosted CI; not executed from this repository checkout
